notes.title: Wild Isles v0.15.0 is Live!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Island generation time is 3x faster! In testing, load time went from ~30 seconds to ~10 seconds.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.14.0 is LIVE!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Grass is now interactable and bends as you walk over it. 
[*] Improved logging.
[/list]

notes.title: Wild Isles v0.12.0 is Live!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now move while holding the map, but at 40% reduced speed.
[*] Compass and spyglass also reduce speed by 20%.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.11.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added "Join Discord" and "Give Feedback" links to main menu. 
[*] Updated loading screen text.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.11.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added camera which saves screenshots locally and uploads them to Steam.
[*] Added item icons with hotkey reminders.
[/list]
